features: Live radio, podcasts and LibriVox audiobooks from OndaCast in one calm player
Every OndaCast station: browse by listeners or by genre, or search by name, city or genre
The song on air with its artwork, and what the station played recently
Subscribe to shows; new episodes land in Listen now, with play next and a queue
Resume episodes and books where you left off, with chapter progress and bookmarks
Speed per show or book, a sleep timer, transcripts that follow along, and Clip to TEND Notes
requirements: A Tend panel that provides the ondacast capability
TEND Notes installed with a notebook, to save clips (optional)
release_notes: 1.1.0: Browse every OndaCast station by genre (Country, Latin, Rock, Pop, Hip-Hop, Easy Listening, Talk & News) and page through search; song artwork and recently played for live radio; a right panel that follows what is playing; resume where you left off; closing the window now stops audio.
